messages:
marco: Heads up 1 vendor 'Aurelia' opened a dispute on AUG invoice. They ran a smoke test that hit prod endpoints and got a big one-day spike. Asking for a grace credit.

elis: Invoice? sample lines? want to see daily breakdown to decide prorate vs goodwill.

marco: INV-2025-4038. Snippet: 
2025-08-09,api-gen,1,18000
2025-08-10,api-gen,1,600
Total billed after retainer = $33,600. They request $18k back.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2025-4038 found. Balance $33,600. Auto-credit cap $7,500. Manual approvals needed above cap.

elis: Ops suggestion: prorate the day of the spike (~$9k) and offer a one-time goodwill of $4k because they are a small partner and this is first incident. Total $13k. @finance-lead can you greenlight $13k?

sophie: Finance lead approves $13,000, GL 5410, memo "aurelia-grace-aug25". Require brief RCA and future key-management checklist.

elis: I'll create CM-2025-1260 for $13,000 and apply to INV-2025-4038. Attaching audit entry when done.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2025-1260 created for $13,000 and applied to INV-2025-4038. Audit note: "approved finance-lead 1785559090".

marco: Sending confirmation and asking for RCA. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
